content:
The final 24 hours of Prime Day 2026 are now underway, folks. Some of the rarest discounts we are tracking for Prime Day this year are actually official Apple accessories with new all-time lows on AirTag 2 and some extremely hard to come by price drops on Magic Mouse, Magic Keyboard, and more.

We also have a collection of deep discounts on charging accessories from Anker and others, joined by a suite of 25W MagSafe charging stands to scope out before Amazon’s biggest sale event of the year shuts down for good.

Last call on AirPods, Macs, more

Down below, you’ll find a selection of the most notable discounts we are tracking on both official Apple accessories and some of our favorite third-party gear still sitting at Prime Day pricing.

But to kick things off, we are dropping what might be the best Apple accessory ever made for any Apple device – the ongoing AirPods Pro 3 at $70 off the list price – alongside a couple of the particularly standout Apple deals before they sell out:

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249)
  • MacBook Neo from $589 ($110 off new list price)
  • MacBook Air from $1,149 ($350 off new list)
  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $279 (Reg. $399) – New all-time low
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 from $309 (Reg. $429) – New all-time low
  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 from $649 (Reg. $799) – New all-time low

AirTag 2

One of the latest Apple accessory releases sitting down at the best price ever is its latest item tracker, AirTag. Complete with an expanded range, a louder speaker, and enhanced privacy features, you can now scoop up a single for $24 or score the 4-pack to bring your per-tag price down to $22 a pop. It might not seem like a giant discount, but this is effectively the first notable discount we have tracked since launch and new Amazon all-time low pricing here:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99)

Apple Magic for Prime Day

The only thing not so magical about Apple Magic accessories is how they are magically almost never on sale. This is Prime Day, though, and nothing is quite as safe as it normally is. We are now tracking a pair of wildly rare discounts, first on the black Apple Magic Mouse that is at the best price we have tracked in over a year, and second on the latest Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric at the best price we have ever tracked on Amazon. While the standard Magic Mouse with the classic white and silver livery does deals a little bit more regularly, it has never been down as low as it is right now:

  • Black Apple Magic Mouse $80 (Reg. $99)
  • White Apple Magic Mouse $60 (Reg. $79)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and Numeric $144 (Reg. $179)

Apple Pencil (USB-C)

Apple Pencil (USB-C) skips some of the premium features from the Pencil Pro, but they’ll not matter much unless you are doing serious digital art or using an iPad as a full-time work tool. For handwritten notes, marking up PDFs, casual sketching, and signing documents, it should be more than enough. It’s the more sensible option for anyone who just wants a reliable stylus without splurging.

  • Apple Pencil (USB-C) $59 (Reg. $79)
  • Apple Pencil Pro $99 (Reg. $129)

Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery

Apple launched the slickest and most elegant iPhone ever this generation with the ultra-thin iPhone Air. It also happened to unleash one of the most elegant power banks out there, specifically tailored to Air’s figure. There are more compact and certainly more affordable models out there (some of the best of them are sitting down below), but the official MagSafe Battery hugs the back an your iPhone Air with Apple precision and it also happens to be sitting at the lowest price we have tracked on Amazon to date at 40% off – and catching any current-generation Apple tech with a price drop like does not happen often.

  • Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery $59 (Reg. $99)

Qi2.2 25W MagSafe wireless chargers and more from $30

Amazon’s Prime Day sale is in its final stretch, and there’s only a few hours left to lock in any charging upgrades you have been putting off. We’re still tracking notable discounts on some of our favorite charging gear, particularly Qi2.2 25W wireless chargers from Anker, Satechi, Belkin, and more. We have rounded up the best Qi2.2 25W charger deals worth grabbing before Prime Day comes to a close, covering everything from compact charging pads and stands to more feature-packed multi-device setups with displays, built-in cooling, and more.
